common.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

states.emptyDescription: No records match the current filters.
states.accessDeniedDescription: This page needs the "{permission}" permission. Ask an owner or admin to grant it to one of your roles.
states.notFoundDescription: The record you're looking for doesn't exist or was removed.

auth.loginSubtitle: Admin panel access for GR8 staff.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.mfaUnsupported: This account requires two-factor authentication, which this admin panel doesn't support yet. Contact the system owner.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
auth.forgotSent: If that email belongs to a staff account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.forgotSentHint: No email service is configured in development — the reset token is written to the API server log.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least {min} characters.

users.title: Staff users
users.description: Accounts that can sign in to this admin panel.
users.createDescription: The account is created first, then you assign roles to it.

hints.emailImmutable: Email can't be changed after the account is created.
hints.passwordOnCreate: Set an initial password. The user should change it after first sign-in.
hints.isActive: Inactive accounts can't sign in. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted, because they're referenced by audit history.

users.empty: No staff users match these filters.
users.deactivateDescription: {name} will no longer be able to sign in. Their history is kept and the account can be reactivated later.
users.noSearchHint: The API doesn't support searching users by name or email yet — filter by status instead.

roles.title: Assigned roles
roles.description: Roles grant permissions. A role can be scoped to a single location.
roles.locationHint: Leave as "All locations" unless this person should only act at one warehouse or store.
roles.expiresHint: Leave empty for a permanent assignment.
roles.empty: No roles assigned. This user can sign in but won't see anything.
roles.revokeDescription: {role} will be removed from {name}. They immediately lose every permission it granted.
roles.assignAtCreationHint: Tick any roles to grant immediately. You can add or remove roles later from the user's page.
roles.assignFailedOnCreate: The user was created, but these roles couldn't be assigned: {roles}. Try assigning them again from the user's page.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Create roles and control which permissions each one grants.
roles.matrixDescription: Tick a permission to grant it to this role. Changes apply to everyone holding the role as soon as you save.
roles.dangerousHint: This permission allows money movement or privilege changes.
roles.confirmDescription: You're granting {granted} and revoking {revoked}. Everyone holding this role is affected immediately.
roles.createDescription: Set the role's name and starting permissions. You can change permissions later from the role's page.
roles.codePattern: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only, starting with a letter (e.g. warehouse_lead).

hints.code: A stable identifier used internally — can't be changed after the role is created.

hints.slugPerLocale: Leave blank to generate from the name. Slugs are unique per language.
hints.code: Internal identifier — can't be changed later.

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name in at least one language.
validation.labelRequired: Enter a label in at least one language.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Brands shown on products across the storefront.
brands.deactivateDescription: {name} will be hidden from the storefront. Products keep their link to it and it can be reactivated later.
brands.empty: No brands yet. Create the first one to start tagging products.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The category tree used for navigation and product grouping.
categories.deactivateDescription: {name} and its position in the tree will be hidden from the storefront. It can be reactivated later.
categories.empty: No categories in this dimension yet.

fields.imageHint: Shown on category tiles in the storefront.

hints.dimension: Categories, collections, and occasions are separate trees.
hints.parent: Choose a parent to nest this category beneath it.

options.systemDescription: Color and Size are the store's two options. Add and edit their values here.
options.title: Options
options.description: Variant-defining options such as size, colour, sleeve, and collar.
options.empty: No options yet. Create one (e.g. Size) then add its values.

values.title: Values
values.description: The choices customers pick from, in display order.
values.empty: No values yet for this option.
values.hexHint: Pick a colour with the box, or paste a hex such as #1B3A2F.

products.deleteDescription: {name} will be removed from the storefront and archived. Existing orders and history are kept.
products.title: Products
products.description: Everything sold in the store, with their variants.
products.createDescription: Set the basics and translations. Variants are added on the product's page after it's created.
products.noSearchHint: The API doesn't support text search on products yet — use the filters.

hints.basePrice: VAT-inclusive price in KWD. Variants can override it.
hints.categories: A product can sit in several categories across dimensions.
hints.isBestSeller: Shows the best-seller badge and includes this product in the storefront's Best Sellers rail.
hints.defaultVariant: Every product has at least one variant — a default one is created automatically.
hints.trackInventory: Off for made-to-order or digital items — always purchasable, and the per-variant quantities below are ignored.

media.title: Media
media.description: Upload images and tag them to a colour so the storefront can swap them per swatch.
media.empty: No media uploaded for this product yet.
media.attachFailed: The file uploaded but couldn't be attached to this product.
media.noListEndpoint: The API has no endpoint that lists a product's existing media, so only files uploaded in this session are shown here.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Every sellable combination, with its own SKU, price, and stock.
variants.matrixDescription: Tick the combinations that actually exist — combinations are created explicitly, never as a full cartesian product.
variants.noOptions: No options defined yet. Create options and values first, then come back to build variants.
variants.limitExceeded: Too many combinations selected. The backend caps a product at 300 variants.
variants.discontinueDescription: {sku} stops being sellable. It is never deleted, because orders reference it.
variants.stockInvalid: Quantities must be whole numbers, zero or more.
variants.trackingOffNotice: Inventory tracking is off for this product, so these quantities are recorded but never checked at checkout.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Warehouses and stores that hold stock.
locations.deactivateDescription: {name} stops being available for new stock movements. Existing history is kept.

hints.fulfilmentPriority: Lower numbers are picked first when allocating an order.
hints.sellableOnline: Whether stock here counts toward what the storefront can sell.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Vendors you raise purchase orders against.
suppliers.deactivateDescription: {name} can no longer be selected for new purchase orders. Existing orders are unaffected.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.description: Order stock from suppliers and receive it into a location.
purchaseOrders.noListHint: The API has no purchase-order list endpoint yet, so open one by its ID or create a new one.

items.title: Line items
items.empty: Add at least one line item.

purchaseOrders.approveDescription: {po} becomes approved and can then be sent to the supplier.
purchaseOrders.sendTitle: Mark this purchase order as sent?
purchaseOrders.sendDescription: Records that {po} has been sent to the supplier.
purchaseOrders.cancelDescription: {po} is cancelled and can no longer be received against.
purchaseOrders.receiveDescription: Record what arrived. Partial receipts are supported — enter only what was delivered.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Customer orders, their payments, and fulfilment.

items.title: Items
items.name: Item
items.snapshotHint: These values are snapshots from when the order was placed, not current catalog prices.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.empty: No addresses recorded on this order.

notes.title: Notes
notes.empty: No notes on this order yet.

status.title: Status
status.noTransitions: No further transitions are possible from this status.
status.confirmDescription: This is recorded in the order's history and the audit log.

payments.title: Payments
payments.empty: No payments recorded on this order.

refund.title: Refund payment
refund.description: Refunds are issued against a single captured payment and can't exceed what's left on it.
refund.amountHint: Up to {max} remaining on this payment.
refund.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
refund.amountTooHigh: That's more than the {max} still refundable on this payment.
refund.noCapturedPayment: This order has no captured payment to refund.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Storefront customer accounts and their addresses.

orders.title: Order history
orders.empty: This customer hasn't placed any orders yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.empty: No settings have been defined yet.
settings.publicHint: Public settings are readable by the storefront.
settings.jsonHint: Values are stored as JSON — use quotes for text, no quotes for numbers, true/false for switches.
settings.confirmDescription: This changes store behaviour immediately and is recorded in the audit log.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every write to orders, payments, prices, roles, and permissions.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

diff.changedOnly: Only the fields that changed are recorded.

banners.title: Banners
banners.description: Hero slides shown in the homepage banner slider.
banners.formDescription: Artwork, overlay text and where the banner links to.
banners.deactivateDescription: {name} will stop appearing on the storefront. It can be reactivated later.

validation.desktopRequired: A desktop image is required, or the banner will not appear.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Static pages such as shipping, returns and terms.
pages.formDescription: Content and SEO for both locales. A page is only visible on the storefront once published.
pages.unpublishDescription: {name} returns to draft and leaves the storefront. Its content is kept.

fields.slugPlaceholder: Left blank, generated from the title

validation.titleRequired: Both Arabic and English need a title.

menus.title: Menus
menus.description: Header and footer navigation shown on the storefront.
menus.noItems: No items in this menu yet.
menus.itemFormDescription: Menu items are fixed — only the label per locale and whether it's shown can change.

validation.labelRequired: Both Arabic and English need a label.
